'''Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team''' (Japanese: '''ポケモン不思議のダンジョン 炎の探検隊''') is a [[Pokémon manga]] created by [[Makoto Mizobuchi]]. It is based on the [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness]] games. 

The story revolves around [[Honō]], an amnesiac human who wakes up as a {{p|Chimchar}}. He meets a cowardly {{OBP|Totodile|Blazing Exploration Team}}, and together, they form Team Blaze.
